authority.business: BRD plus accepted decisions in integration_spec.md
authority.module_structure: shared/contracts Python models and matching JSON Schemas
authority.database: Alembic migrations, not the workbook catalog alone
authority.evaluation: pinned split and independently reviewed expected annotations

execution_modes.modules: real source bytes, including remote HTTP(S); stop on failure; no QA fallback
execution_modes.modules_di_reference: explicit DEV/EVAL only: DI reference if bytes not local, real remaining modules

assessment_scope.comparison: compare identical family set; report coverage outside annotated families separately

dataset_baseline.scope_authority: ASSESSMENT_SCOPE.json: full catalog; case DRAFT_REVIEW narrows evaluation target, not legal applicability

knowledge_approval.basis: Explicit owner instruction: hãy coi là tôi sẽ duyệt hết rồi đi
knowledge_approval.scope: All knowledge rows in this pinned snapshot; disabled rules remain disabled

unknown_policy: Never change unknown facts into known values or legal noncompliance to increase metrics

execution_semantics.process: One assessment job; in-process module calls; business branches are logically independent but currently sequenced
execution_semantics.retry: Provider attempts, queue infrastructure recovery and explicit new run are separate mechanisms

knowledge_review_semantics.HUMAN_VERIFIED: Reviewed snapshot, not automatic approval of extracted runtime facts
knowledge_review_semantics.c09_reviewed_knowledge: True only for snapshot HUMAN_VERIFIED in current producer
knowledge_review_semantics.c10_citation_gate: Missing reviewed_knowledge or finding verification may yield CITATION_PRODUCTION_GATE diagnostic, not an asserted citation risk

synthetic_evidence_policy.ordinary_input: source-only verifier when source/snapshot do not match
synthetic_evidence_policy.knowledge_review: unchanged; explicit scenario may authorize SOURCE_CHECKED draft inputs
synthetic_evidence_policy.report_audit: evidence_mode=SYNTHETIC; scenario/source hashes; never human approval
